rows.en:
(Another beautiful day~
Perfect beach weather!)
rows.notes: Male, frd_myk_005 (beach at the artificial island).

rows.en:
Ah, Shirakawa's already here!
I've gotta hurry!!
Sorry I kept you waiting, Shirakawa.
N-no, I only just got here myself...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, both genders (betsu ni ima kita tokoro).

rows.en: Oh, okay. Good. Let's get going, then.

It's packed, just like I figured.
Wonder if there's an open spot?
Oh, I'll go get changed first.
Okay, see you in a bit.
(She's not here yet, huh.)
rows.notes: Male; waiting for Miyuki to come out in her swimsuit.

rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, both genders (omatase shimashita, as the recurring line).

rows.en: (Well, well, well...)
rows.notes: Male; kore wa, kore wa, admiring her swimsuit.

rows.en: Oh, honestly! D-don't stare at me like that!
S-sorry!
Come on! Let's just go already!!

Ah, hey!
Don't yank my hand so hard!!
rows.notes: Male; she drags him by the hand.

rows.en: The water's so nice and cold!
Take that!
rows.notes: x6: player splashing here; Sheryl serving in tennis (frd_she_003) and splashing (frd_she_007). Works for all.

rows.en: Eek, cold! Stop it!

Oh, honestly! If that's how it's gonna be,
two can play at that game!!
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; kocchi datte (I'll do it too).

rows.en: Phew~ I'm beat...

Honestly, that's what you get
for getting so worked up, \p-kun.
Okay, guess I'll go buy us some drinks and...
rows.notes: Male; the sentence is cut by c10760 (katte... -> teeeee), cut at the same point.

rows.en: ...aaand WHAAAAAAT?!?!
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; continues c10759/c10788 (the te of katte stretched into a scream).

rows.en: Wh-what is it? All of a sudden...

Y-your chest!
Sh-Shirakawa!!
rows.notes: Male; her swimsuit top has slipped after the splash fight.
x2, Miyuki; wordless shriek, as c07645.

rows.en:
D-don't look!
You can't loooook!!!

Bwah! I-I'm not looking!
I'm not looking, so calm down!

Don't look!
Nooooooo!!!
C-can't... breathe...
rows.notes: Male; gurudii = kurushii slurred (she is smothering him).

rows.en:
That was fun today.
We got to play so much!
Hmph!
rows.notes: Male, Miyuki; tsuun = turning away in a sulk.

rows.en: Come on, that was... an unfortunate accident...

I suppose so...
But... I had fun too...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; answers c10770 (male) and c10793 (female).

rows.en: I see. That's good, then.
rows.notes: x4, player: after 'I had fun too', 'Today was fun' (island visit) and 'I only just got here' (frd_myk_006); works for all.

rows.en: Will you invite me again?
Yeah, of course!
Shall we head home, then?
Yeah, let's!
rows.notes: x5: player here and in frd_rnk_005, Ranka in nml_rnk_001; always answers a suggestion. Matches the female 'Yeah, let's!' (c08921).

rows.en:
(Today was a really fun day.
And I got an eyeful of something nice, too!)

(Another beautiful day~
Perfect beach weather!)

Ah, Miyuki's already here!
I've gotta hurry!!
Sorry I kept you waiting, Miyuki.
Oh, okay, good. Come on, let's go!

It's packed, just like I figured~
Wonder if there's an open spot?
Why don't we go get changed first?
(I came out ahead of her, but...)
rows.notes: Female; out of the changing room.

rows.en: So cuuute~!!
rows.notes: Female; about Miyuki in her swimsuit.

rows.en: Let's gooo!

Honestly, that's what you get
for getting so worked up.
Well, guess I'll go buy us some drinks and...
rows.notes: Female; cut into c10760 as in the male version.

rows.en:
Y-your chest!
M-Miyuki!!
I-I've gotta cover her up!
rows.notes: Female; kakusanakya, the player moves to hide Miyuki.

rows.en: Oh nooo, this is awful~!!
Oh, um, yes...

That was kind of an accident...
so maybe you shouldn't let it bother you...
Yeah, of course!
(Today was a really fun day~!)

(Today it's vacation time
on the artificial island!)

S-sorry to keep you waiting,
\p-kun.
It's nice out, so let's have a blast today too!

Y-yes...
Let's have lots of fun.
rows.notes: Male, Miyuki (still shy after the first trip).

rows.en: So, what should we do?

Let's swim way out!
First one to the buoy wins!
I won't lose.
Neither will I! Off I go~
rows.notes: Male; osaki ni = jumping the start.

rows.en: Ah, no fair!

Heh heh!
The race has already started!
Today was fun.
(And no 'mishaps' this time, either.)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; harks back to the swimsuit incident.

rows.en: ...Is something the matter?

N-nothing!
Okay, let's head home!!
(Today was a fun day!)

(Today it's vacation time
on the artificial island!)
It's nice out, so let's have a blast today too!

Yes.
Let's have lots of fun.
Neither will I! Off I go~!

Ehehe!
The race has already started!
Yeah, I'm glad to hear it.

uncertain: c10759/c10760/c10788: the Japanese cuts 'katte...' into a scream 'teeeee'; rendered as 'and...' / '...aaand WHAAAAAAT?!?!' so the shared c10760 works after both lead-ins.
